goal: Defeat the Ender Dragon and use the End exit portal; distinguish kill credit, win-game event and return.
scope: Vanilla survival completion on the configured Paper 1.18.1 baseline. No commands, glitches or creative shortcuts are assumed; routes and preparation are not universal prerequisites. Checks are historical observed facts, not a claim of unaided accomplishment.

steps.title: Obtain wood
instructions: Find a reachable tree or another legal wood source.
Break a log with the attack control, complete mining, and collect the drop.
steps.minimum: A normal self-crafted tool route starts with wood; exact total depends on selected tools/fuel.
steps.alternatives: Loot/village workstations or existing equipment can skip wood gathering.

steps.title: Obtain planks
instructions: Put a log/stem into the personal 2×2 crafting grid.
Take the output; one ordinary log/stem produces four matching planks.
steps.minimum: 4 planks for a new crafting table; other recipes consume more.
steps.alternatives: Found/looted planks also satisfy possession, but do not prove crafting.

steps.title: Craft planks
instructions: Select a valid log-to-planks recipe, take the result, and clear unused grid items.
steps.minimum: One batch when crafting planks yourself.
steps.alternatives: Skip if using found planks.

steps.title: Obtain a crafting table
instructions: Arrange four planks in the 2×2 inventory grid.
Take the crafting table, or collect an existing one.
steps.minimum: 1 reusable table for recipes needing 3×3.
steps.alternatives: An accessible village/existing table can replace a carried one.

steps.title: Open a crafting table
instructions: Place or find a reachable table.
Use it to open the 3×3 crafting menu.
steps.items: 1 accessible crafting table; placement does not consume it permanently.
steps.minimum: No new table if one already exists.
steps.alternatives: 2×2 recipes such as eyes do not require a table.

steps.title: Obtain sticks
instructions: Place two planks vertically; collect four sticks.
Retain unused sticks for later tools.
steps.minimum: 2 sticks per pickaxe; 1 per sword; 3 per bow.
steps.alternatives: Dead bushes, leaves/loot or found tools can replace crafting.

steps.title: Obtain a wooden pickaxe
instructions: Use three planks across the top and two sticks down the center.
Take and equip the wooden pickaxe.
steps.minimum: 1 for the conventional stone-tool bootstrap.
steps.alternatives: A found stone-or-better pickaxe skips this tier.

steps.title: Mine stone-tier material
instructions: Find exposed stone/cobblestone or deepslate.
Mine with a sufficient pickaxe and collect cobblestone/cobbled deepslate.
steps.minimum: 3 drops for a stone pickaxe; 8 more for a furnace.
steps.alternatives: Loot stone tools or find a furnace instead.

steps.title: Hold 11 stone-tier blocks
instructions: Collect enough material for a stone pickaxe and furnace.
steps.items: 11 cobblestone/cobbled deepslate, usable by the corresponding recipes.
steps.minimum: 3 + 8 = 11 for these two crafted objects.
steps.alternatives: Possession threshold is a supply check; spent materials may mean this checkpoint is never observed even if later stages succeed.

steps.title: Obtain a stone pickaxe
instructions: Craft with three cobblestone/cobbled deepslate and two sticks, or obtain an equivalent higher-tier tool.
Use a stone-or-better pickaxe for iron ore.
steps.minimum: 1 stone pickaxe for the conventional iron route.
steps.alternatives: Found higher-tier pickaxe bypasses this exact tier.

steps.title: Obtain a furnace
instructions: Arrange eight cobblestone/cobbled deepslate around an empty center.
Take it and place it near a fuel/ore supply, or use an existing furnace.
steps.minimum: 1 reusable furnace for smelting route.
steps.alternatives: Found furnace or looted/traded iron ingots can skip crafting.

steps.title: Open a furnace
instructions: Use a reachable furnace to access input, fuel and output slots.
steps.minimum: No extra material when using existing station.
steps.alternatives: Other accepted iron-smelting station or found ingots can replace it.

steps.title: Obtain smelting fuel
instructions: Mine coal or prepare charcoal/other furnace fuel.
Put enough fuel in the fuel slot to smelt selected ore.
steps.items: Coal/charcoal, ordinary wood or other valid fuel.
steps.minimum: 1 coal/charcoal smelts up to 8 items; selected bucket+igniter route needs 4 ingots.
steps.alternatives: Nether wood is not ordinary wood fuel; do not assume every plank/log item burns. Looted ingots bypass smelting.

steps.title: Obtain raw iron
instructions: Mine iron/deepslate iron ore with a stone-or-better pickaxe.
Collect raw iron drops.
steps.minimum: 4 raw iron for one crafted bucket plus flint and steel.
steps.alternatives: Found ingots, golem drops or other legal iron sources bypass raw ore.

steps.title: Obtain four iron ingots
instructions: Place raw iron/ore in furnace input and fuel in fuel slot.
Wait for processing, collect ingots, and reserve three for the bucket and one for the igniter.
steps.minimum: 4 for this chosen bucket-cast/igniter route; not a universal game minimum.
steps.alternatives: Found buckets/igniter or alternate ignition can lower required ingots.

steps.title: Obtain food
instructions: Gather, hunt, farm or loot edible items.
Cook applicable foods or use a safe edible source; keep a travel supply.
steps.items: Edible food; amount depends on travel, damage and difficulty.
steps.minimum: No fixed universal count; food is practical preparation, not an End-portal ingredient.
steps.alternatives: Peaceful/no-hunger training rules change this requirement.

steps.title: Eat food
instructions: Select suitable food, hold use until consumption completes, and release.
Avoid harmful foods or account for their effects.
steps.minimum: As needed; not a fixed mandatory number.
steps.alternatives: A food item in inventory is not proof that it has been eaten.

steps.title: Obtain a conventional melee weapon
instructions: Craft/obtain a sword or axe and reserve durability for the fight.
steps.items: Sword: 2 matching material units + 1 stick; axe: 3 + 2 sticks.
steps.minimum: 0 weapons strictly required; bare-hand damage exists.
steps.alternatives: Beds/explosions are another combat route; tools and fists can also damage.

steps.title: Obtain a shield
instructions: Craft with six planks and one iron ingot; equip appropriately.
steps.minimum: 0 mandatory; 1 recommended for hazards.
steps.alternatives: Shield does not make all dragon attacks harmless.

steps.title: Obtain iron chest armor
instructions: Craft or loot armor; equip the appropriate slots.
steps.items: Iron chestplate: 8 ingots. Full iron set: 24 ingots (5+8+7+4).
steps.minimum: 0 armor strictly required.
steps.alternatives: Other materials and enchantments are optional; possession is not proof of equipment.

steps.title: Hold building blocks
instructions: Gather blocks for bridging, pillaring, shelters and escape routes.
Do not assume a fixed stack suffices for every seed/platform layout.
steps.minimum: Terrain-dependent; 64 is a useful supply checkpoint, not a guaranteed minimum.
steps.alternatives: Pearls/terrain can replace some bridges; Nether fire hazards affect material choice.

steps.title: Obtain a bed
instructions: Craft three wool of the same color and three planks, or collect a village bed.
Use only safe Overworld sleeping if setting a checkpoint.
steps.items: 3 same-color wool + 3 planks per crafted bed.
steps.minimum: 0 mandatory for completion.
steps.alternatives: Beds explode in Nether/End; a combat bed is consumed by the explosion.

steps.title: Sleep in the Overworld
instructions: Place/use bed in the Overworld under valid sleep conditions; establish a practical recovery point.
steps.minimum: Optional checkpoint.
steps.alternatives: Nether/End bed use explodes rather than setting ordinary bed spawn.

steps.title: Obtain a bucket
instructions: Craft three ingots in a V shape or obtain a bucket elsewhere.
steps.minimum: One bucket can suffice with suitable existing water/flow arrangements; two simplify repeated casting.
steps.alternatives: Existing portal or mined obsidian can bypass bucket casting.

steps.title: Obtain a water bucket
instructions: Use an empty bucket on a water source.
Preserve water placement/access for lava casting and later safety.
steps.minimum: One reusable water supply for the chosen route.
steps.alternatives: A fixed water source/flow and one repeatedly emptied bucket can replace two carried buckets.

steps.title: Obtain a lava bucket
instructions: Find a lava source, use a bucket to collect it, and plan safe placement.
steps.minimum: Ten source-lava placements for a wholly new cornerless cast frame; bucket reused.
steps.alternatives: Existing obsidian frame/ruined portal reduces new placements.

steps.title: Obtain flint
instructions: Mine gravel until flint drops, or loot/trade it.
steps.minimum: 1 flint for crafted flint and steel; gravel drops are random without applicable enchantment.
steps.alternatives: Other ignition routes remove this item requirement.

steps.title: Obtain a portal igniter
instructions: Craft flint and steel with one flint and one iron ingot; reserve durability.
steps.items: 1 iron ingot + 1 flint, or fire charge/other ignition source.
steps.minimum: 1 ignition action on a valid frame.
steps.alternatives: Lava-caused fire, existing lit portals or found igniters avoid the recipe.

steps.title: Obtain three diamonds (mining alternative)
instructions: Use iron-or-better pickaxe to mine diamond ore, or obtain diamonds from loot/trade.
Reserve three for a diamond pickaxe if mining obsidian.
steps.items: 3 diamonds; iron pickaxe recipe adds 3 ingots + 2 sticks.
steps.minimum: 0 diamonds for bucket casting; 3 for self-crafted diamond pickaxe.
steps.alternatives: Found diamond/netherite pickaxe replaces crafting.

steps.title: Obtain an obsidian-capable pickaxe
instructions: Craft diamond pickaxe with three diamonds and two sticks, or obtain diamond/netherite pickaxe.
steps.minimum: 0 for casting directly into frame; 1 for survival obsidian drops through mining.
steps.alternatives: Bucket casting/looted obsidian bypasses this tool.

steps.title: Hold ten obsidian (mining/loot alternative)
instructions: Mine obsidian with sufficient tool or loot it.
Build a vertical frame with 2×3 empty interior; corners can be omitted.
steps.items: 10 obsidian for cornerless 4×5 outer footprint; 14 if corners included.
steps.minimum: 10 frame blocks in the world; inventory obsidian can be 0 when casting directly.
steps.alternatives: Ruined/existing frames reduce missing blocks. Crying obsidian cannot form a normal Nether portal.

steps.title: Observe an active Nether portal
instructions: Complete valid frame, remove obstructing interior blocks, ignite inside, and verify purple portal blocks.
Keep a safe route back.
steps.items: Valid obsidian frame + ignition; interior at least 2×3.
steps.minimum: One active portal; it may preexist.
steps.alternatives: Sighting proves an active local portal, not that this agent built/ignited it.

steps.title: Enter the Nether
instructions: Move into the active portal, wait for dimension transfer, and verify destination.
steps.minimum: Required for self-sourced blaze rods in ordinary fresh survival, not for an already filled End portal.
steps.alternatives: World must allow Nether travel; do not use beds there for normal sleeping.

steps.title: Obtain gold armor for piglin safety
instructions: Craft/loot and equip a gold armor piece when traveling among piglins.
steps.items: Gold boots: 4 gold ingots; another armor piece can substitute.
steps.minimum: 0 mandatory; one equipped piece reduces ordinary piglin hostility under its rules.
steps.alternatives: Possession alone does not prove it is equipped; mining gold/opening containers can still provoke piglins.

steps.title: Reach a Nether fortress
instructions: Explore safely until entering a generated fortress bounding region.
Locate blaze spawning areas without falling/lava exposure.
steps.items: Navigation/survival capability; no fixed consumable ingredient.
steps.minimum: One fortress for conventional blaze route.
steps.alternatives: Advancement proves entering the structure, not discovering a spawner specifically.

steps.title: Observe a blaze spawner
instructions: Find and approach a reachable fortress spawner or naturally spawning blazes.
Use cover and respect spawner activation distance.
steps.items: Reachable blaze source; non-Peaceful ordinary mob spawning.
steps.minimum: Spawner not mandatory if natural fortress blazes are available.
steps.alternatives: Sighting a spawner alone does not identify its mob type; the block-entity data must say blaze.

steps.title: Kill a blaze
instructions: Fight a blaze, survive, and receive player kill credit.
steps.items: Any effective attack method; conventional weapon/cover optional.
steps.minimum: At least one credited kill; rod count depends on random drops and looting.
steps.alternatives: Only credited kill statistics confirm this milestone; merely seeing a blaze die is insufficient.

steps.title: Obtain a blaze rod
instructions: Collect a rod from player/qualifying kill drops or legally supplied resources.
steps.minimum: ceil(E/2) rods for E crafted eyes, before other blaze-powder uses.
steps.alternatives: Ordinary fresh survival cannot replace blaze powder with another eye ingredient; a prefilled portal avoids eye production.

steps.title: Hold six blaze rods
instructions: Continue collecting rods until the selected eye budget is available.
steps.minimum: 6 for 12 crafted eyes with no other powder use; more for search losses/brewing.
steps.alternatives: You may craft incrementally and never hold six at once; this supply checkpoint is not a prerequisite gate.

steps.title: Obtain blaze powder
instructions: Put a blaze rod in personal crafting grid; take both powder items.
steps.minimum: 1 powder per newly crafted eye.
steps.alternatives: Brewing stand/fuel is optional and spends extra rods/powder.

steps.title: Craft blaze powder
instructions: Take the powder output from a valid recipe.
steps.minimum: ceil(E/2) rods gives enough powder for E eyes.
steps.alternatives: Possession alone is tracked separately from crafting evidence.

steps.title: Return to the Overworld
instructions: Use a Nether portal and verify an Overworld spawn before searching for a stronghold.
steps.minimum: No additional consumed material for an existing safe return portal.
steps.alternatives: An initially Overworld agent does not satisfy this transition; tracker requires earlier observed Nether presence.

steps.title: Kill an Enderman (hunting route)
instructions: Find Endermen and use a safe combat method, such as a low shelter or water escape.
Receive kill credit and collect dropped pearls.
steps.items: No fixed recipe; effective attack/survival method.
steps.minimum: Pearl drops are random; no fixed kill count guarantees the target amount.
steps.alternatives: Trading or bartering can skip hunting entirely.

steps.title: Obtain gold ingots (bartering route)
instructions: Acquire ingots via mining/smelting, nugget conversion or loot.
Use ordinary adult piglins, not piglin brutes, for bartering.
steps.items: Gold ingots; 9 nuggets craft 1 ingot; 1 gold block gives 9 ingots.
steps.minimum: Random barter outcomes mean no finite guaranteed ingot count for a pearl target.
steps.alternatives: A barter yields a batch of 2–4 pearls when the pearl outcome occurs in 1.18.1; hunting/cleric route avoids this budget.

steps.title: Confirm a piglin barter
instructions: Give/drop gold ingot to an eligible adult piglin, wait for processing and collect output.
steps.minimum: One ingot per barter; repeated RNG outcomes may be needed.
steps.alternatives: Holding both gold and pearls does not prove bartering.

steps.title: Open a villager trade menu (cleric route)
instructions: Find or establish a cleric using a brewing stand and valid villager profession conditions.
Level trades to the pearl-selling tier; inspect actual offers.
steps.items: Villager, workstation if creating cleric, trade goods/emeralds; a crafted stand needs 1 rod + 3 cobblestone/blackstone.
steps.minimum: Generated offers/leveling costs determine actual emerald and goods budget.
steps.alternatives: This detector proves a merchant menu was opened, not that it was a cleric or offered pearls.

steps.title: Complete a villager trade
instructions: Select a real offer, supply inputs, take output, and receive advancement.
steps.minimum: No fixed universal count; repeated purchases depend on offer/restock limits.
steps.alternatives: Any trade confirms trading capability; pearls still require the actual pearl offer.

steps.title: Obtain an Ender pearl
instructions: Collect a hunted, bartered, traded or looted pearl.
steps.minimum: 1 pearl per crafted eye, plus any thrown for travel.
steps.alternatives: Pearls spent as teleports are unavailable for crafting.

steps.title: Hold twelve Ender pearls
instructions: Gather the pearl budget for an unfilled portal before consuming travel/search supplies.
steps.minimum: 12 only for 12 new eyes, no search loss or teleport spending.
steps.alternatives: Prefilled frames reduce needed eyes; incremental crafting may bypass this possession checkpoint.

steps.title: Obtain an Eye of Ender
instructions: Combine one pearl and one blaze powder in personal crafting grid and take one eye.
steps.items: 1 Ender pearl + 1 blaze powder → 1 Eye of Ender.
steps.minimum: One eye per missing portal frame; zero if all 12 are prefilled.
steps.alternatives: Finding a stronghold without eye throws is possible; throwing eyes does not activate a portal.

steps.title: Craft an Eye of Ender
instructions: Take the actual recipe output.
steps.items: One pearl and one powder per eye.
steps.minimum: E eyes require E pearls and E powder.
steps.alternatives: This milestone uses crafting statistics, not inventory coincidence.

steps.title: Hold twelve Eyes of Ender
instructions: Prepare a complete unfilled-portal eye budget before insertion.
steps.minimum: Portal insertion count is 12 − prefilled frames; search losses are additional.
steps.alternatives: This is a conservative supply checkpoint, not universally mandatory.

steps.title: Use an Eye of Ender for navigation
instructions: Use an eye in the Overworld, follow its flight, recover it if it drops, repeat/triangulate as needed.
Reserve enough intact eyes for insertion.
steps.items: Reusable eye if it returns; replacement eyes if it breaks.
steps.minimum: No fixed worst-case search-loss budget; no throws needed for an already-known stronghold.
steps.alternatives: Use statistic confirms use, but does not prove an independent successful triangulation.

steps.title: Reach a stronghold
instructions: Travel to the indicated area, dig a safe approach, and enter the generated stronghold.
steps.minimum: One reachable stronghold with a portal room.
steps.alternatives: The Eye Spy advancement is location-based in 1.18.1; eye throwing is not a prerequisite for receiving it.

steps.title: Observe End portal frames
instructions: Search corridors/stairs for the portal room; handle silverfish and lava hazards.
Inspect all twelve frame blocks and count existing eyes.
steps.items: Existing generated frame ring; frames cannot ordinarily be crafted/placed in survival.
steps.minimum: 12 correctly arranged inward-facing frames; one surviving usable portal room.
steps.alternatives: Local frame sighting does not prove the full ring or count all prefilled eyes.

steps.title: Observe a filled End portal frame
instructions: Use eyes on empty frames; preserve existing filled frames.
steps.minimum: P = 12 − s where s is prefilled count; P can be 0.
steps.alternatives: Sighting an eye-filled frame does not establish that this agent inserted it.

steps.title: Observe an active End portal
instructions: Fill all missing eyes, verify active portal blocks inside the ring, and finish preparation before jumping in.
steps.items: Complete filled frame ring; usable portal.
steps.minimum: No extra eye if already active.
steps.alternatives: Activation can be performed by another player; observation is not ownership credit.

steps.title: Enter the End
instructions: Move/jump into the active End portal and verify End dimension.
Check spawn platform, void exposure and nearby island before moving.
steps.items: Active End portal; bridging/pearls if terrain requires them.
steps.minimum: Entering the End is required; a survival escape route is not automatically available until dragon defeat.
steps.alternatives: Spawn-platform geometry controls required bridge/travel supplies.

steps.title: Reach the main End island
instructions: If platform is separated, bridge/pillar or use a valid pearl trajectory; move to stable End stone.
steps.minimum: No universal block count; no bridge if platform is already connected.
steps.alternatives: Tracker verifies nearby End stone while in End, not the quality of every bridge movement.

steps.title: Obtain a bow (ranged route)
instructions: Craft/loot a bow and obtain ammunition; practice aim before End hazards.
steps.minimum: 0 bows mandatory; 1 for conventional ranged crystal/flying attacks.
steps.alternatives: Crossbow costs 3 sticks + 2 string + 1 iron ingot + 1 tripwire hook; other damage routes exist.

steps.title: Obtain ammunition
instructions: Craft with flint, stick and feather or collect/trade arrows; select compatible ammunition.
steps.minimum: No fixed universal count; misses/crystal route/enchants alter consumption.
steps.alternatives: Infinity bows need an eligible arrow; crossbows and special ammunition have their own rules.

steps.title: Obtain carved pumpkin (optional)
instructions: Shear a placed pumpkin and collect/equip carved pumpkin for Enderman gaze protection.
steps.items: Pumpkin + shears if crafting this way; shears cost 2 iron ingots.
steps.minimum: 0 mandatory; 1 optional head item.
steps.alternatives: It reduces vision and does not prevent every cause of Enderman aggression.

steps.title: Observe an End crystal
instructions: Identify crystals on obsidian pillars and which are caged.
Plan ranged shot or safe pillar access; account for explosion radius.
steps.items: No item consumed just to observe.
steps.minimum: Crystal destruction is a practical fight plan, not logically necessary if damage outpaces healing.
steps.alternatives: Seeing a crystal disappear or a nearby explosion is not proof this agent destroyed it.

steps.title: Destroy healing End crystals
instructions: Shoot exposed crystals or reach them using safe traversal.
For caged pillars, reach a safe position and open iron bars with a suitable method.
Break crystals without standing in their explosion, then verify remaining healing sources.
steps.items: Weapon/projectile or safe melee access; blocks/water as needed.
steps.minimum: Zero strictly required for theoretical completion; ordinary fresh fights generate ten pillars/crystals.
steps.alternatives: There is no fixed arrow/block budget and no requirement to collect crystal items.

steps.title: Damage the Ender Dragon
instructions: Track flying/perching phases, avoid breath/knockback/void, and attack valid vulnerable parts.
Use conventional attacks or a safely executed explosion route; continue until lethal damage.
steps.items: Any successful damage method; beds/materials conditional.
steps.minimum: Damage is required to defeat it; no specific sword/armor/bow item is mandatory.
steps.alternatives: Observing damage alone does not identify the attacker.

steps.title: Prepare beds for explosive combat (alternative)
instructions: Obtain sufficient beds and protective positioning blocks.
Place/use a bed near a valid dragon-perch setup in the End, keep explosion shielding, and repeat if needed.
steps.items: Each crafted bed: 3 same-color wool + 3 planks; protective block/setup.
steps.minimum: No fixed guaranteed bed count; damage depends on placement/timing. Each exploded bed is consumed.
steps.alternatives: Conventional melee/ranged attacks skip this route entirely.

steps.title: Receive Ender Dragon kill credit
instructions: Complete the fight and receive Free the End advancement or a player dragon-kill statistic.
steps.minimum: One defeat for initial completion.
steps.alternatives: Seeing another player's kill, rewards or a spawned exit portal is not this agent's kill credit.

steps.title: Observe the active End exit portal
instructions: After dragon defeat, approach the central exit fountain and verify active portal surface.
steps.items: An active central End exit portal.
steps.minimum: One usable exit portal.
steps.alternatives: A portal at a stronghold is not an End exit; tracker requires current End dimension.

steps.title: Trigger the End completion/credits event
instructions: Enter the central End exit portal after the dragon fight.
Receive the server's win-game event; a rendered client may display the End poem/credits.
steps.items: Active End exit portal; no item consumed.
steps.minimum: One valid win-game event. Headless bots do not have a rendered credits screen.
steps.alternatives: The event alone does not prove this same agent killed the dragon; those milestones stay separate.

steps.title: Return from the End via the completion route
instructions: Finish/skip credits or allow the client backend's ordinary respawn response.
Verify a subsequent Overworld spawn/dimension after the End exit event.
steps.items: No additional item; normal server/client lifecycle.
steps.minimum: A return after the recorded win-game event.
steps.alternatives: Death or an admin teleport alone does not satisfy this detector.

steps.title: Obtain the dragon egg (not required)
instructions: Collect the egg through a valid torch/piston or other survival method after its teleport mechanic.
steps.minimum: 0 for completion.
steps.alternatives: Egg is a trophy, not an ingredient needed to finish the game.

steps.title: Use an End gateway (not required)
instructions: After dragon defeat, use the gateway to reach outer islands by safe pearl/crawl/other valid method.
steps.minimum: 0 for initial completion.
steps.alternatives: Advancement confirms gateway traversal, not return credits.

steps.title: Reach an End city (not required)
instructions: Explore outer islands and enter an End city.
steps.minimum: 0 for completion.
steps.alternatives: Not all cities have a ship.

steps.title: Obtain elytra (not required)
instructions: Find an End ship and collect the elytra.
steps.items: Ship access; optional flight rockets/repair materials later.
steps.minimum: 0 for completion.
steps.alternatives: Not a prerequisite for first dragon fight.

steps.title: Respawn the dragon (not required)
instructions: Place four End crystals around the exit fountain in the valid pattern.
steps.items: 4 crystals; each crafted from 7 glass + 1 Eye of Ender + 1 ghast tear.
steps.minimum: 0 for first completion; crafted respawn set uses 28 glass + 4 eyes + 4 tears.
steps.alternatives: Repeated dragon fights and all-advancement completion are separate goals.

resources.minimum: P = 12 − s inserted eyes; E = P + L crafted/search replacement eyes.
resources.notes: s is prefilled-frame count (0–12); L is unrecovered broken/lost eye consumption. Extra deliberately stored spare eyes are additional. A fully prefilled portal needs 0 crafted eyes.

resources.minimum: E pearls for E crafted eyes, plus pearls actually spent on travel.
resources.notes: RNG drops/barters have no finite guaranteed kill/ingot count; item possession does not identify source.

resources.minimum: E powder; ceil(E/2) rods if converting rods only.
resources.notes: 1 rod gives 2 powder; brewing/cleric workstation costs extra. Twelve new eyes cost 12 pearls + 12 powder = 6 rods.

resources.minimum: 10 obsidian frame blocks (cornerless) or 14 with corners; subtract usable existing blocks.
resources.route: Bucket casting / diamond mining / loot / ruined portal
resources.notes: Cast blocks can remain in world: no obsidian inventory stack required. Crying obsidian is invalid. A prelit portal skips construction/ignition.

resources.minimum: Crafted bucket 3 iron; flint and steel 1 iron + 1 flint: 4 iron total.
resources.notes: One reusable bucket with suitable water flow can suffice; two buckets raise budget to 7 iron with igniter. Repeated lava sources are needed. Found tools/natural ignition alter budget.

resources.minimum: Table 4 planks; sticks 2 planks → 4; wooden pick 3 planks + 2 sticks; stone pick 3 stone + 2 sticks; furnace 8 stone.
resources.notes: Combined: 9 planks (at least 3 ordinary logs giving 12 planks), 11 cobblestone/cobbled deepslate, plus iron ore/fuel. Remaining 3 planks may be fuel. Found stations/tools bypass costs.

resources.minimum: 4 raw iron/ore + enough fuel for 4 smelts in chosen casting/igniter route.
resources.notes: 1 coal/charcoal can smelt 8 items. Making charcoal has its own log/fuel cost; ordinary planks are another fuel route. Standard route need not consume diamonds.

resources.minimum: Diamond pick 3 diamonds + 2 sticks; iron pick 3 iron + 2 sticks if crafting ore-mining prerequisite.
resources.notes: 0 diamonds for casting/looted obsidian. Existing diamond/netherite tools bypass recipes.

resources.minimum: No fixed guaranteed barter budget; gold boots 4 ingots if crafting piglin armor.
resources.notes: Adult piglins barter ingots; brutes do not. Gold armor safety is conditional, not invulnerability.

resources.minimum: Offer/level-dependent emeralds and goods; crafted brewing stand 1 blaze rod + 3 cobblestone/blackstone.
resources.notes: Actual generated pearl offer, level, prices and restock behavior determine budget; no universal fixed emerald count.

resources.minimum: Sword 2 material + 1 stick; axe 3 material + 2 sticks; shield 6 planks + 1 iron.
resources.notes: None of these specific items is universally mandatory; bare-hand/explosion damage alternatives exist.

resources.minimum: Bow 3 sticks + 3 string; arrow batch 1 flint + 1 stick + 1 feather → 4 arrows.
resources.notes: Exact shots needed are skill/route-dependent. A 64-arrow crafted reserve uses 16 each flint/stick/feather; not a minimum guarantee.

resources.minimum: Iron set 24 ingots (helmet 5, chest 8, legs 7, boots 4).
resources.notes: 0 mandatory; other materials/enchants substitute. Shield/armor do not protect against the void.

resources.minimum: 3 same-color wool + 3 planks per crafted bed; bed count is fight-dependent.
resources.notes: Overworld sleep optional; beds explode in Nether/End. No fixed number guarantees dragon defeat across timings/damage.

resources.minimum: Travel-, difficulty-, terrain-, damage- and skill-dependent; no universal count.
resources.notes: Carry enough building blocks, edible food, water and durability for selected route; don't present recommended stacks as mathematical minima.
